metadata.description: Bloom ke courses aur single sessions ek hi jagah par explore kariye.

Library.title: Hamari library explore kariye
Library.introduction: Bloom ke sessions aur courses, jo aapko seekhne, chintan karne aur apne anubhavon ko samajhne mein madad karte hain — ek surakshit aur sashakt banane wali jagah mein.
Library.kindLabel: Content ke prakaar se filter kariye

noResults.title: In filters ke liye koi result nahi mila
noResults.body: Ek-do filter hataakar dekhiye, ya koi doosri theme explore kariye — library mein aapke liye aur bhi bahut kuch hai.

recognising-abuse.label: Abuse ko pehchanna
recognising-abuse.blurb: Rishton mein aur rozmarra zindagi mein abuse ko naam dena
recognising-abuse.description: Abuse hamesha saaf dikhai nahi deta. Jaaniye ki yeh rishton mein aur rozmarra zindagi mein kaise dikh sakta hai, aur un anubhavon ke liye shabd dhoondhiye jinhe naam dena mushkil raha hai.

why-abuse-happens.label: Abuse kyun hota hai
why-abuse-happens.blurb: Abuse ke peeche ki samajik aur vyavasthagat vajahon ke bare mein jaaniye
why-abuse-happens.description: Abuse sirf ek vyakti ke faislon se nahi banta. Un samajik, sanskritik aur vyavasthagat shaktiyon ko samjhiye jo abuse ko hone deti hain — aur yeh ki isme se kuch bhi aapki galti nahi hai.

body-after-trauma.label: Trauma ke baad aapka sharir
body-after-trauma.blurb: Trauma sharir mein kaise basta hai
body-after-trauma.description: Trauma jitna mann mein hota hai, utna hi sharir mein bhi. Jaaniye ki aapka nervous system aapke anubhavon par kaise pratikriya karta hai, aur suraksha mehsoos karne ke komal, sharir-aadhaarit tareeke.

setting-boundaries.label: Boundaries banana
setting-boundaries.blurb: Bhavnatmak, sharirik, yaun aur digital boundaries
setting-boundaries.description: Boundaries zindagi ke har hisse mein aapki bhalai ki raksha karti hain. Jaaniye ki bhavnatmak, sharirik, yaun aur digital boundaries ko kaise pehchanein, banayein aur banaye rakhein.

healing-journey.label: Aapki healing journey
healing-journey.blurb: Shok, vikaas aur recovery ke beech apna raasta dhoondhna
healing-journey.description: Healing seedhi rekha mein nahi chalti. Shok, vikaas aur recovery se guzarne ke liye saath aur tools paiye — us raftaar se jo aapko sahi lage.

staying-safe.label: Abhi surakshit rehna
staying-safe.blurb: Safety planning aur chalti hui hinsa se nipatna
staying-safe.description: Agar aap abhi bhi hinsa mein hain ya uske kareeb hain, toh suraksha sabse pehle aati hai. Safety planning ke liye aur un palon se nipatne ke liye vyavaharik sahayata paiye jab cheezein surakshit na lagein.
